newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade slow at $64, steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade slow at $64, steady - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry wa s good and demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 400 slaughter heifers Thursday. Confirmed - 900
For the week to date 89,200 head confirmed including 23,200 head or about 26 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1275 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.00.
